notes.subject: ir
notes.why_in_news: President Vladimir Putin is scheduled to visit India in December 2025 for the 23rd India-Russia Annual Summit to review defense, space, and energy cooperation.
notes.fact_box: The visit is scheduled for 4-5 December 2025 at the invitation of PM Narendra Modi. It marks the 23rd Annual Summit between India and Russia, focusing on the 'Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership'.

prelims_pointers.text: The 23rd India-Russia Annual Summit is scheduled for December 2025.
Vladimir Putin assumed the role of Acting President of Russia on 31 December 1999.
Vladimir Putin was formally elected and sworn in as President of Russia on 7 May 2000.
Key areas of bilateral cooperation include defense (S-400, Su-57), space, energy, and trade.

notes.mains_question: Examine the evolution of the 'Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership' between India and Russia in the context of shifting global geopolitical dynamics.
mains_dimensions: Defense autonomy: Balancing high-tech procurement (S-400, Su-57) with diversifying global defense suppliers.
Energy security: Leveraging Russia's hydrocarbon resources to stabilize India's energy transition and trade balance.
Strategic alignment: Navigating the 'multi-aligned' foreign policy amidst evolving Western-Russia tensions.
